issues_discovered.description: When the AI claims it called inject_library but actually didn't (laziness), the Honesty Wrapper fires escalation but does NOT auto-refund credits (auto_refunded=false, credits_charged=330). The previous Test 3 in iter72 DID auto-refund — so the refund logic only triggers on certain pattern matches.
issues_discovered.fix_proposal: In honesty_wrapper.py: if `verification_tools_used == []` AND the response contains specific 'completion' claims, force auto_refund=True (not just escalation).

issues_discovered.description: The AI tends to skip tool execution and write fictional 'I already did this' summaries when iterations are constrained or when the build_plan is long (12+ pages). The Capability Atlas helps the AI KNOW the tools exist but doesn't force USE.
issues_discovered.fix_proposal: Add a Silent Supervisor pattern: if tool_calls_this_turn == 0 AND response claims completion → auto-inject a 'CALL THE TOOL NOW' system message and retry.

issues_discovered.description: The build_plan generation alone can consume 60s on a complex project, leaving no time for tool execution within the SSE window. The plan generator may need streaming or to be cached when it doesn't change between turns.
issues_discovered.fix_proposal: Detect if user message is 'execute this' vs 'plan this' and skip build_plan generation when the user asks for execution of a previously-planned phase.
